verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's own marketing names a built-in 'Grafana Assistant' and 'Investigations' among its AI-powered capabilities, and promises natural-language understanding of production systems. That establishes an in-product AI assistant, but the evidence is a single product-page mention: nothing documents what tasks can be delegated or how. The MCP server evidence covers external agents connecting to Grafana, which is a separate capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of what tasks the Assistant can perform or delegate (building dashboards, writing queries, running investigations), docs on how users invoke it, availability details (Cloud-only vs OSS), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Includes AI-powered capabilities for engineering teams, including Grafana Assistant, Investigations, Agent Observability, and more.
Understand production systems faster using natural language
